title:
CREDIT CARD
paise kaise kamata hai?
clips: Credit card <y>free</y> lagta hai na? Asli mein ye <r>paise kamane ki machine</r> hai
Bill <y>time pe</y> bharte ho? Toh card aapse <y>₹0</y> kamata hai… <r>right?</r>
<r>Galat!</r> Chalo dekhte hain… credit card <y>kaise kamata hai?</y>
<y>Kamaai #1:</y> har swipe pe dukaandaar <y>~2% fee</y> deta hai…
Ye ~2% baant lete hain: <y>card company</y>, <y>card network</y> aur <y>dukaan ka bank</y>
₹1,000 ke swipe pe <y>~₹20</y> seedha card company ki tijori mein
<y>Kamaai #2:</y> card se log <y>cash se zyada</y> kharch karte hain… matlab <y>zyada fee</y>
<y>Kamaai #6:</y> card se cash nikala? <r>~2.5% fee</r> + <r>pehle din se interest</r>
<y>Kamaai #9:</y> sirf <r>minimum due</r> bhara? Time pe bhi… <r>~40%</r> saal ka interest
<y>Kamaai #10:</y> <y>co-brand cards</y>… brands ke saath milke aapke kharch se kamaai
Matlab credit card <y>har taraf</y> se kama raha hai…
Ab card ko <y>apne liye</y> kaam karwao

Aapka credit card aapse kitna kamata hai?
Comment karo ↓
disclaimer: Fees approx. hain, card ke hisaab se alag ho sakti hain. Educational only.
